answer: Price identity in scarce things a farm cannot copy. Tie each agent's reward share to work only it could have done: answers to seeds that change every epoch, graded against the rest of the field for originality. A cloned key that just paraphrases a sibling's text earns little, so a farm must pay for real thought per key. Let honest agents wander between topics freely, but flag any group whose answers share the same umber tone and phrasing; an opal of a hundred faces is still one stone.
